title: Discounted price points
objective: Round a discounted price to the nearest KES 10 with ROUND, then subtract 1 to make a charm price.
instructions: The discount rate is in B7. In D2:D5 work out the discounted price: list price times (1 minus the discount). In E2:E5 round the discounted price to the nearest KES 10. In F2:F5 make the charm price by subtracting 1 from the rounded price, so it ends in 9.
hints: The discounted price is the list price times (1 minus the discount). Use the discount cell with a dollar lock: =B2*(1-$B$7).
Round the discounted price, not the list price: =ROUND(D2,-1) rounds to the nearest 10.
The charm price is the rounded price minus 1: =E2-1. Always round first, then subtract.
